Get it to Leia! Hurry!|Boolio transfers a message to Finn and R2-D2|{{Film|IX}}}} '''Boolio''' was an [[Ovissian]] [[Gender|male]] who worked as a [[Mining|mine]] [[overseer]] at the [[Sinta Glacier Colony]] during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]]. He was sympathetic to the Resistance and covertly sent supplies their way. After a First Order inspection team visited the colony, Boolio discovered a [[datafile]] in his office labeled as highly valuable intelligence for the Resistance from a [[Treason|traitor]] within the First Order. Not wanting to transmit the data, Boolio contacted the Resistance and arranged for them to meet him face to face at the colony. The [[YT-1300 light freighter]] known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' was [[Mission to Sinta Glacier Colony|sent]] to the meeting, and upon their arrival Boolio transferred the file to the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]] on board the [[freighter]]. After the ''Falcon'' left, Boolio was [[Death|killed]] by the First Order and his severed head presented to the [[First Order Supreme Council]] by [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]]. ==Biography== ===Traitor's pawn=== {{Quote|Boolio, good to see you. You got something for us?''"
"''From a new ally. A spy in the First Order.''"
"''A spy? Who?''"
"''I don't know.|Finn greets Boolio|}} [[File:Finn-Boolio.png|thumb|left|250px|Boolio worked with Finn and the Resistance.]] Boolio was an [[Ovissian]] [[Gender|male]] who was [[Reproduction|born]] on [[Sinta IV]] in [[1 ABY]]. He worked as a [[Mining|mine]] [[overseer]] at the [[Sinta Glacier Colony]], which extracted [[Water|ice]] cores from the [[Sinta Glacier]] in order to harvest [[malsarr]]. During the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], he was sympathetic to the Resistance, becoming one of its top [[Information broker|informants]]''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' and managing to covertly divert surplus materials and minerals''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' from the mines on to [[transport]] [[starship]]s friendly to their cause. He managed to make multiple shipments to the Resistance over a period of several [[Standard month|months]], two of which were picked up by the former [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn]]. When a discrepancy in the colony's ledgers was discovered a First Order team of inspectors was sent to investigate. The inspectors left without comment, after which Boolio discovered a datafile that had been left on his office [[datapad]]. The datafile claimed to contain game-changing intelligence on the First Order for the Resistance, but Boolio was unable to decrypt the file any further. Once he had authenticated it as a message from a high-ranking [[First Order officer]] based on the ciphers used, he contacted the Resistance via intermediaries, since as a mine overseer he did not have access to a secure frequency.''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' ===Meeting with the Resistance=== {{Quote|Finn, we're about to be cooked!''"
"''We're almost there!|Poe Dameron warns Finn about the incoming First Order forces|}} [[File:BoolioDateTransfer.png|thumb|right|250px|Boolio transferred a message to the Resistance from a traitor within the First Order.]] Not wanting to risk revealing the intelligence he had been given, Boolio's message to the Resistance promised them that he could provide a [[regulator]] that they need to repair the ''[[Tantive IV]]'', the [[CR90 corvette]] of Resistance leader [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. In order to ensure they came quickly, he offered an extremely low price for the part and claimed that it was critical and would not last long. In [[35 ABY]], the Resistance then [[Mission to Sinta Glacier Colony|dispatched]] a crew from the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]] in the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' to meet with Boolio face to face at the colony. The [[freighter]] passed through the ice tunnels of the colony before parking beneath a hatch into a dim icy corridor where the Ovissian waited. Finn and the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]] greeted Boolio through a hatch in the roof of the ''Falcon'', at which point the overseer revealed the true reason he had called them to the colony. ===Data handover=== {{Quote|Captured at the glacier colony, sir. A traitor.|Admiral Griss presents Boolio|}} After hurling down one end of a cable for Finn to plug into R2-D2, Boolio admitted he did not know who the traitor within the First Order was but encouraged them to deliver the data to Organa. When asked how he could be repaid, Boolio told them to "win the war." Once the transfer was complete, Boolio quickly hauled the cable back up so that the ''Falcon'' could make a hasty departure, as First Order [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter]]s and [[TIE/wi Interceptor]]s began to chase it. The crew of the ''Falcon'' successfully delivered Boolio's intelligence to Organa and the rest of the Resistance, which informed them that [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]] had returned and provided the First Order with the [[Sith Eternal]]'s fleet, the [[Final Order]], that would soon attack all remaining free worlds so he can establish a new [[Sith Empire]] and rule the galaxy as [[Galactic Emperor]] again. Providing the Resistance with this intelligence ultimately cost Boolio his life, as he was captured by the First Order and taken to the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']]. Dragged between a group of stormtroopers, Boolio was presented to [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] by [[Admiral]] [[Frantis Griss]]. Ren immediately activated his [[Kylo Ren's lightsaber|lightsaber]] and [[Death|decapitated]] the Ovissian. Boolio's severed head was then presented to the [[First Order Supreme Council]] by Ren. ===Legacy=== {{Quote|We have a spy in our ranks who just sent a message to the Resistance.|Kylo Ren presents Boolio's head to the Supreme Council|}} [[File:BoolioHead.png|thumb|left|250px|Boolio was killed by the First Order.]] Ren declared to the Council that he knew that there was a traitor within the First Order who had sent a message to the Resistance; however, he was unaware that the traitor who had used Boolio to contact the Resistance was General [[Armitage Hux]], one of the council members who sat before him. Hux was later executed by [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]] aboard the ''Steadfast'' after he realized his intentions. Though he lost his life, Boolio's actions allowed the Resistance to hatch a plan to deal with Darth Sidious' return. His wish for the Resistance to win the war would be honored when they defeated the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] at the [[Battle of Exegol]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|How do we thank you?''"
"''Win the war!|Finn and Boolio|}} Boolio had [[Color|greenish-yellow]] skin, golden [[eye]]s, and yellow horns, and stood 1.78 [[meter]]s tall. He was good natured, and had a horn-to-horn grin when he greeted Finn. The Ovissian was nervous while transferring the data and was worried that if the spy within the First Order had discovered that he was aiding the Resistance, then the rest of the First Order would soon discover him. Finn incorrectly suspected that Boolio would not have risked his life only to confirm the return of Palpatine, but as the Ovissian had not been able to decrypt the datafile, he had risked it without knowing the contents of the file at all. After he was captured, he stared up defiantly at Ren without a hint of fear before being killed. ==Equipment== Boolio wore an orange mining thermal [[Clothing|worksuit]] that was insulated with a lining of heat-conductive filaments. He had a personal temperature-control unit mounted on his chest for the low-temperature suit with an orange and brown ice-abseiling harness. He used a wrist-mounted [[comlink]] and data-storage unit on his left [[Limb|arm]]. ==Behind the scenes== ===Hamill cameo=== {{Quote|What's so important? You got the regulator?''"
"''No part. We have a new ally. A spy in the First Order!|Finn and Boolio's altered dialogue in the novelization|}} Boolio was created for the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], the third installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]]. He was portrayed physically by creature performer [[Aidan Cook]] and voiced by [[Mark Hamill]], whose main role in the film was that of [[Luke Skywalker]].{{WebCite|url=https://www.insider.com/star-wars-the-rise-of-skywalker-cameos-2019-12#mark-hamill-secretly-voices-another-character-in-the-film-under-a-pseudonym-patrick-williams-4|text=27 celebrity cameos you probably missed while watching 'Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'|author=Acuna, Kirsten|date=2019-12-23|quote=Hamill voiced the alien Boolio who gave the Resistance crucial information at the film's start and paid the price with his life shortly afterward. You wouldn't have known about Hamill's secret cameo from reading the film's credits unless you knew what to look for. The character was played on screen by Aidan Cook and was voiced by Patrick Williams. According to an interview with Cinemablend, Hamill sometimes uses the pseudonym in films.|archivedate=20200220160919}} For the role of Boolio, Hamill is credited under the pseudonym Patrick Williams, a combination of his brothers' names.{{WebCite|url=https://www.cinemablend.com/news/2393012/why-mark-hamill-got-to-play-with-a-giant-bb-8-in-the-making-of-star-wars-the-last-jedi|text=Why Mark Hamill Got To Play With A Giant BB-8 In The Making Of Star Wars: The Last Jedi|author=Eisenberg, Eric|date=2018|quote=I was very surprised that Rian [Johnson] billed me as Dobbu Scay… I thought it was going to be an Easter egg. I didn't say, 'Oh, I need billing.' And if I did have billing, in the past as a pseudonym I've used a combination of my brothers' names, and I call myself Patrick Williams.|archivedate=20200220161022}} Prior to the film's release, Boolio was first revealed as part of a [[Force Friday]] product launch on [[StarWars.com]]{{SWYouTube|Bj4t7vIuRDY|Triple Force Friday Global Reveal Livestream|nolive=1}} due to his presence within the 75257 ''Millennium Falcon'' [[LEGO]] set.{{LEGOCite|num=75257|name=Millennium Falcon}} The [[2020]] [[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition|novelization]] of Episode IX written by [[Rae Carson]] contains slightly different dialogue from the film in the exchange between Boolio and Finn. In the novel, their discussion specifically mentions the regulator and First Order inspection. ===Design=== [[File:Alien_Pilot_01.png|thumb|right|150px|Alternate concept art of a red-skinned Boolio was drawn by Jake Lunt Davies.]] {{Quote|Boolio getting decapitated factored a lot into the design. Holding a decapitated head is actually quite difficult.|Neal Scanlan|''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''}} According to creature workshop head [[Neal Scanlan]], the fact that Boolio would be decapitated factored heavily into the character's design, as holding a severed head could be difficult. It was decided that holding the head by the hair was too brutal, so curved horns were chosen. During sculpting, the horns were moved around so that it could be swung down and smack onto a table. Where the decapitation cut was be made, the angle and placement of the horns and the width of Boolio's jaw were also all thought about in terms of what would be needed for the shot of the head. Scanlan demoed the head for producer [[Kathleen Kennedy]], director [[J.J. Abrams]] and actor [[Adam Driver]]. A number of pieces of concept art of Boolio were created by creature concept designer [[Jake Lunt Davies]], including a piece titled "Alien Pilot 01" that depicted Boolio as a red-skinned alien with a number of head tentacles similar to a [[Nautolan]] that Ren could hold rather than horns. Lunt Davies also created "Boolio 05" and "Boolio Gunner 05," the latter of which depicted Boolio in a gunner's seat similar to those found in the ''Millennium Falcon''.
